new_claims.statement: For independent H,L with density caps m_H,m_L, arbitrary Borel q and t!=0, ||p_{q(H)+2tHL}||_3 <=3|t|^(-2/3)(m_Hm_L)^(2/3).
For W of density cap m_W, ||p_{lambda(W-s)^2}||_(3/2)<=2m_W^(2/3)|lambda|^(-1/3).
For mutually independent H,L,W, Q=q(H)+2tHL+lambda(W-s)^2+c has continuous C0 density with sup <=6|t|^(-2/3)|lambda|^(-1/3)(m_Hm_Lm_W)^(2/3).

partner_result_applied.application: At Q0=2HL+W^2 with independent cap-one H,L,W, gives ||p_Q0||_(infinity,ess)<=7.761982175235.

unresolved_implication: QFORM-INDEFINITE-PAIR-L3-v1: extend the L3 pair-density bound to a general physical indefinite 2x2 quadratic with both diagonal entries nonzero, uniformly at scale |det B|^(-1/3), preserving product provenance.
notes: The previous scalar-pivot half-Riesz log barrier is removed on the split-source collar by retaining the bilinear hub in L3 and spending the independent square in L3/2. This does not solve shared-source square carriers or the full conjecture.
